narrative: The technology sector is experiencing dynamic shifts, with major players like Apple and Microsoft adjusting to new market conditions and AI advancements impacting various facets of development. Breakthroughs in AI are not only driving innovation in areas like chip technology and research but are also raising important policy and ethical considerations.

highlights.title: Heat waves mess with your brain. Scientists are trying to figure out why.
highlights.whyItMatters: Understanding the neurological impacts of extreme weather events is critical for public health.

highlights.whyItMatters: The availability of advanced AI models with strong safeguards on cloud platforms expands access to responsible AI.
